programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Angie & Hannah who say step-father & step-grandfather Ralph routinely sexually abused them. For the first time in 15 years, Angie & Hannah are face-to-face with Ralph, who denies all claims. Is Ralph cleared by a polygraph test?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After former friends Randi & Haley tell Brittany's history of harassing men & faking pregnancies, Dr. Phil talks to Brittany and asks her to prove she is pregnant. What sent Brittany storming off stage? See the backstage conversation with Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Calah Waskow, 15, made national news when allegedly abducted by her friend's 37-year-old dad. Issuing an Amber Alert, Calah was found five days later. What happened to her? Did she have a secret relationship with the older man? Calah tells her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Divorced parents Christina and Jim along with daughter Tara, 21, discuss that dad's new wife is the same age as Tara, how it's ok Tara is a webcam model to help pay bills, and that all this is making Tara a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Best Time Of My Life Portraits Of Women In Mid-Life, The
programme.desc: An upbeat, positive film about a group of women dealing with mid-life and menopause. The women come from a wide range of backgrounds, careers and lifestyles, it effectively dispels popular myths and fears about life during and after menopause.

programme.title: Waterwalker
programme.desc: Accompany Bill Mason on a canoe journey through Ontario's wilderness, from Lake Superior to the river's source. Enjoy breathtaking visuals, whitewater excitement, and Mason's reflections on nature, art, and canoeing, with Bruce Cockburn's music.

programme.title: Spirit Of The Kata
programme.desc: Five women, all of them black belts in karate, are examples of how this ancient martial art can transform lives. They demonstrate how it can generate a whole range of physical, psychological and spiritual benefits.

programme.title: Minoru Memory Of Exile
programme.desc: The bombing of the American naval base at Pearl Harbor, by a nation he knew only by name, thrust nine-year-old Minoru Fukushima into a world of racism so malevolent he would be forced to leave Canada, the land of his birth.

programme.title: I Want To Be An Engineer
programme.desc: This film provides a lively introduction to the professional and personal lives of three female engineers--just a few of the growing number of women who are opting for "non-traditional" jobs.

programme.title: Toward Intimacy
programme.desc: "Toward Intimacy" celebrates the rights of women with disabilities to pursue intimate relationships. This one-hour film features personal stories from four Canadian women, addressing sexuality, self-esteem, stereotypes, and parenting.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Twelve elite female competitors battle across two daunting courses; the top 4 finishers advance to race head-to-head on the Power Tower, with the winner taking home $50,000 and becoming the second American Ninja Warrior Women's Champion.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Fan favourites compete in the wildest head-to-head ANW competition ever; iconic obstacles get super-sized -- some as high as 80 feet -- as all-star ninjas face off on challenges including the Big Dipper, Spring Forward and the first-ever Cat Grab.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Ten ninja families compete relay-style on a six-obstacle course in teams of three family members.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Competitors from all over the country take on TV's toughest obstacle course and this year it is even tougher. Who will rise to the challenge, conquer Mount Midoriyama and be crowned the UK's first Ninja Warrior?

programme.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programme.desc: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Technology
programme.desc: The only daily news program focused exclusively on technology, innovation and the future of business hosted by Ed Ludlow from San Francisco and Caroline Hyde in New York.

programme.title: Bloomberg Real Yield
programme.desc: Sonali Basak discusses stories from the fixed income world with big names in the field.

programme.title: Bloomberg Markets
programme.desc: The most important global business and breaking markets news and information as it happens.
